name: Getty Images
author: Viboplr
description: Editorial photos of an artist — concerts, portraits, archive shots — from Getty Images, as links: a Getty Images tab on artist pages, and a photo search for AI assistants. Nothing is downloaded or saved; each photo opens on Getty Images.

permissionReasons.system:open: Open a photo, or the full search, on Getty Images in your browser

informationTypes.name: Getty Images
informationTypes.description: Editorial photos of the artist on Getty Images, as links

assistant.instructions: Getty Images editorial photo search (concerts, portraits, press and archive shots), returned as LINKS. search_photos is read-only and slow (it loads Getty's search page in a hidden window, several seconds a call, one at a time), so search once with a good phrase rather than many times. Every photo is Getty's licensed property: `url` is its page on Getty Images — give that to the user, with the photographer and collection as credit. `thumbUrl` is Getty's 612px preview, without a watermark. A cue sheet only links to a picture, so a preview is fine there: credit it in the caption as place and date, then 'photo: <photographer> / <collection> via Getty Images'. 612px is enough for a boxed or half-frame shot but soft for a full-view one. Never save or download a preview, or use it as artist or album art. The artist's best-matching Getty photos already arrive in get_cue_context's `images`; call search_photos for a particular event or year ('Portishead Glastonbury 1998'). Captions are the photographers' own and usually name the event, place and date — use them to pick the right photo instead of guessing from the thumbnail.

tools.name: search_photos
tools.description: Search Getty Images for photos. Returns { total, page, lastPage, searchUrl, photos: [{ id, url (its Getty Images page), title, caption, photographer, collection, date, year, people, orientation, thumbUrl (612px preview, no watermark) }] }. Links only: the photos are licensed, so link to them and credit the photographer, and never save or download them. Read-only.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. 'Portishead', 'Beth Gibbons 1995' or 'Glastonbury 1998 Portishead'

family.description: editorial (default): news, events and people — what you want for a musician. creative: staged stock photos

orientation.description: Keep only photos of this shape (default any)
